by_arrival.arrival: an assistant using the MCP tools

service_time_source: measured against production, not this run

faults.title: Supabase pauses after ~7 days idle (free tier)
faults.detail: 14% of requests touch the database. A paused project degrades 73,500 requests/month to the fallback path. The pages still render — that was built — but the district summary, peers and insights go dark.

faults.title: /query is the only unbounded cost
faults.detail: At 1.5% of visitors it is $1/month. At 10% it is $9. sql/create_nlp_usage.sql is NOT applied in production, so the ceiling is still per-serverless-instance rather than global — the one number here that can run away.

faults.title: Vercel Hobby is non-commercial
faults.detail: 31.7 GB/month uncompressed. Hobby includes 100 GB and forbids commercial use; this volume is a Pro conversation either way.
